assets.name: concept
assets.prompt: Create a beautiful high fidelity desktop web UI concept for Bark's game marketplace. Reference images show the established UI style and the definitive Byte mascot. Use icy blue background, white panels with 24px corners, rounded navy Nunito typography, electric blue selection, lime green Play actions, tiny lilac accents. Byte MUST match the orange cartoon puppy with cream muzzle/paws, blue collar and white cursor-shaped pendant from character sheet, not the 3D B-pendant dog. Page header bark, Explore (active), Create, Log in, blue Join Bark. Compact wide pale mint hero: left eyebrow MADE BY IMAGINATION, headline Your next adventure starts here., subheading Little worlds. Big possibilities., green Surprise me button. Right illustration Byte exploring floating little islands with crystals and stars. Below hero search field Search games and category pills All games, Adventure, Platformer, Puzzle, Racing. Heading Pick a world. Press play. small Featured sort. Six gorgeous 16:10 illustrated game cards in 3-column 2-row grid with art, title, by Bark, tiny genre pill: Woodland Wander, Cloud Hop, Crystal Maze, Moon Bounce, Rainbow Rally, Garden Quest. Distinct themed covers. Spacious but game focused composition. Bottom small Byte and Made for the joy of playing. No metrics, commerce, prices, or fake social activity. Realistically implementable, exceptionally polished playful game browser. One single full webpage concept, crisp labels.
